name: San Mateo Small Business Development Center
description: No-cost, confidential advising on business planning, access to capital, marketing, compliance, and other small business needs
fullDescription: The San Mateo SBDC, part of the Northern California Small Business Development Center network, provides no-cost, confidential business advising and training to help small businesses start, grow, and succeed in San Mateo County.
whatTheyOffer:
- No-cost one-on-one business advising
- Help with business planning and strategy
- Access to capital and help with loan applications
- Guidance on human resources, compliance, marketing, and accounting
- Workshops and free on-demand webinars
howToGetIt:
1. Visit the San Mateo SBDC website or call the center
2. Sign up for SBDC advising
3. Complete intake form describing your business needs
4. Get matched with an advisor
5. Meet for ongoing support as needed
keywords: SBDC, San Mateo, Small Business Development Center, business consulting, business plan, loans, funding, cash flow, entrepreneur, disaster relief
